description: Helper functions for Chromium protocol handling in Playwright, including exception message parsing, stream reading/writing, and input mask conversions.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Constructs a string message from exception details, including stack trace if available.

methods.name: releaseObject
methods.description: Releases a runtime object in the Chromium session.

methods.name: saveProtocolStream
methods.description: Reads a protocol stream from the client and saves it to a file.

methods.name: readProtocolStream
methods.description: Reads a protocol stream from the client and returns it as a Buffer.

methods.name: toConsoleMessageLocation
methods.description: Converts a stack trace to a console message location object.

methods.name: exceptionToError
methods.description: Converts exception details into a JavaScript Error object.

methods.name: toModifiersMask
methods.description: Converts a set of keyboard modifiers to a bitmask.

methods.name: toButtonsMask
methods.description: Converts a set of mouse buttons to a bitmask.
